What complex number is represented in the Argand diagram above? Use $i$ to denote the imaginary unit.

$z=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The coordinates of the point are $(0,-6).$

- The real part of this complex number is $x=0,$ and

- the imaginary part is $y=-6.$

Therefore, the number depicted is $z=0-6i,$ which can be simplified to $z=-6i.$
